newsitem.title: USA: Greenspan Humphrey-Hawkins testimony due Feb. 26.
newsitem.headline: Greenspan Humphrey-Hawkins testimony due Feb. 26.

text.p: Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan will deliver the first leg of his semi-annual Humphrey-Hawkins testimony to Congress on Feb. 26, a spokesman for the Senate Banking Committee confirmed on Wednesday.
The hearing will begin at 10:00 a.m. (1500 GMT).
Greenspan is scheduled to appear before the House Banking Committee on Feb. 27 to deliver the second and final leg of his Humphrey-Hawkins testimony.
